implementation: The XLSX fragment reads the original four break attributes through AttributeList. Only positive manual break positions reached through rowBreaks or colBreaks are installed in ScTable.

ODF row and column automatic styles use fo:break-before and repeated spans. Calc worker transfer restores native sets, and old records without break fields retain their defaults.
